manufacturers.description: Affordable, durable hardware built around conventional components. Novacrest equipment is inexpensive to acquire but tends to be heavier on power and less specialised.
Dependable professional equipment balancing output, power demand and purchase cost for working pilots and security fleets.
Aggressive high-performance systems tuned for pursuit, manoeuvrability and combat response, usually at the cost of increased power demand.
Rare precision technology delivering exceptional efficiency and advanced performance at a correspondingly exceptional price.

equipment.description: A balanced energy shield with strong energy absorption and limited kinetic deflection.
Adds hull strength and reduces kinetic damage at a small improvement against energy damage.
A standard 100 FLX craft power core supplying the ship and every fitted system from a single dependable output budget.
The dependable standard propulsion unit fitted to newly registered Warp Skimmers.
A tuned mercenary drive with a higher velocity ceiling and more responsive thrust control.
A high-output pursuit drive intended for dangerous interception and extraction contracts.
Standard stabilisation, vectoring and bank-control avionics for light strike craft.
Improved response processors and vectoring actuators for tighter combat manoeuvres.
Competition-grade control hardware delivering aggressive response across every manoeuvring axis.
An entry-level cargo recovery field that transfers tagged freight across short distances. Its limited reach demands a close, low pass through any surrounding defences.
A stabilised medium-range cargo translocator that recovers freight without forcing the pilot directly over its position.
A high-end recovery field with enough reach to extract mission cargo from outside many defensive envelopes.
A compact short-range analysis suite for resolving tagged structures and anomalous contacts. Its limited reach forces the pilot close to defended survey sites.
A stabilised medium-range survey array with improved contact retention, allowing useful analysis passes outside many light defensive envelopes.
A long-range military survey suite with a broad acquisition cone and resilient signal memory, designed to identify objectives beyond dense defensive screens.
